page_title: MNU 3-0 WHU | Manchester Utd v West Ham 04/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' The resulting corner from James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

90+6' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and West Ham will take a corner.
90+5' The attendance for today's match is 73612.
90+4' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
90+3' Marcus Rashford links up with Scott McTominay (Manchester United), who fires just wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
88' It's time for a substitution. Antony (Manchester United) comes on in place of Rasmus Hojlund.
87' Here is a change. Luke Shaw is going off and Erik ten Hag gives the last tactical orders to Victor Lindelof (Manchester United).
87' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) receives the ball from Maxwel Cornet and tries to beat the keeper from long range, but the effort goes high over the bar.

84' 3 - 0 Goal Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United)! Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) was put through by Scott McTominay and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 3:0.
83' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
82' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United).

82' A lofted cross from Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. Manchester Utd force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
81' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
80' A rebound sits up nicely for Kalvin Phillips (West Ham) and he needs no second invitation to shoot from distance. The effort, however, balloons high over the bar and out for a goal kick.
79' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) tackles a bit over-zealously and Andy Madley blows for a foul.
77' Kurt Zouma (West Ham) wins the ball from the corner kick and strikes. The effort lacks accuracy and goes miles wide of the left post.
77' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
77' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 10:16. The current number of shots on goal is 4:3.
72' David Moyes decides to make a substitution. Tomas Soucek will be replaced by Maxwel Cornet (West Ham).
72' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Vladimir Coufal as he is replaced by Kalvin Phillips (West Ham).
72' Emerson (West Ham) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
71' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes the corner which is cleared.

71' The free kick is delivered by James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. West Ham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
71' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Raphael Varane.
70' The injury to Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
70' Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
69' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender.
68' Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) is able to continue to play.
68' Kurt Zouma (West Ham) is penalised for holding. Andy Madley signals a set piece.
66' Looks like Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
65' Some neat passing and movement from West Ham as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
64' Kobbie Mainoo goes off the pitch and Scott McTominay (Manchester United) comes on.

63' A cross by Benjamin Johnson (West Ham) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester Utd.

58' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. A rebound falls kindly for Marcus Rashford (Manchester United), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
56' Bruno Fernandes picks out Diogo Dalot (Manchester United), who drives a shot just wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
54' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
54' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Now Manchester Utd have a corner.
53' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

52' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball is out of play. West Ham will have a chance to score from a corner.
51' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the right post.
50' Kurt Zouma (West Ham) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul.
49' 2 - 0 Goal! Bruno Fernandes plays it to Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Alphonse Areola. 2:0.
48' Emerson (West Ham) gets himself into a promising goalscoring position, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar.
47' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Alphonse Areola (West Ham) is replaced by Lukasz Fabianski.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Big chance! A simple pass from Alejandro Garnacho left Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) with just the keeper to beat inside the box, but his shot went agonisingly just past the left post.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) picks up a pass, nutmegs an opponent and goes for glory with an effort from distance. It's a poor effort, however, and goes well wide of the left post.
42' That's unlucky! Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
41' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) connects with a precise cross from the corner kick, but his close -range header hits one of his teammates and thus the score doesn't change.
41' The referee awards a corner and James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) goes over to take it.
40' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. West Ham force their opponents to concede a corner.
40' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
37' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
36' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

34' Luke Shaw nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
31' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) finds the space inside the box to meet a cross, but his effort from near the penalty spot towards the right post is saved by the goalkeeper.
31' The total number of attempts is 3:8. The shots on goal statistics – 3:1.
27' Benjamin Johnson (West Ham) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance towards the left side of the goal, but Andre Onana is alert and makes a decent save.
26' The corner from James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) is intercepted by the defence.

26' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass. Benjamin Johnson (West Ham) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. West Ham will take a corner kick.
25' Poor challenge! Luke Shaw (Manchester United) is penalised for tripping and Andy Madley blows his whistle. West Ham have a free kick.
23' 1 - 0 Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) picks up the ball on the edge of the penalty box and produces a moment of magic with a brilliant shot that goes into the left side of the goal!
20' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by James Ward-Prowse (West Ham), but he hits it straight in the defensive wall.
19' Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul after Lisandro Martinez (Manchester United) hacks down one of his opponents. West Ham have a free kick from a promising distance.
18' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) prepares to take a corner kick.

18' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) meets a cross just outside the area and gets in a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play. West Ham are awarded a corner kick.

15' A neat pass is well received by Diogo Dalot (Manchester United), who is lurking on the edge of the box and produces a low drive directed towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
15' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner with a short pass.

15' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the top right corner, but Alphonse Areola has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. Manchester Utd get a corner.
15' Manchester Utd work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
14' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Manchester Utd.
14' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
12' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by James Ward-Prowse (West Ham), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.

11' What a great chance for Edson Alvarez (West Ham). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the right post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
11' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
10' A cross from Benjamin Johnson (West Ham) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. West Ham win a corner.
9' The ball is cleared after Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
8' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) plays a lovely through ball to Emerson, but he can't beat Andre Onana and loses the ball.
6' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alphonse Areola intercepts the ball.
4' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
3' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) jumps into a tackle and Andy Madley signals a foul.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Manchester Utd will have the kick-off.
Andy Madley was nominated as the referee for this game.
